answer: The canyon schedule is applied in river and lotus reveals each instalment. An hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4046 identities would post 4915 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
